**Renamed `calcTotal` to `computeTotal` everywhere.**

Four files changed: `cart.js` (the function and its comment), plus `index.js`, `invoice.js`, and `report.js`.

The one `calcTotal` left is in `tests/total.test.js:18`, which checks the old name is gone. That's on purpose.

All 4 tests pass in 0.07s. Run them with `node --test tests/total.test.js` — pointing at the folder fails on this Node.
